input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract: each unit's order is a commit, and the contract refuses
any order that breaks one of its rules. It already has the rule that only a unit can write its own order.
The contract's state, which rules can test (the referee commits /world before the units order):
  /world/step.num                 half seconds since the battle began
  /world/allies_alive.num         our living units
  /world/enemies_alive.num        their living units
  /world/focus.text               the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, e.g. E1
  /world/<unit>/hp.num            every unit's health (A0.. ours, E0.. theirs)
  /world/<unit>/alive.bool        true or false
  /world/<A>/closest.text         the living enemy closest to our unit A
  /world/<A>/in_range.num         how many enemies our unit A can shoot now
  /orders/<A>.text                our unit A's order, e.g. "attack E1", "hold", "retreat", "move 10 12"
Each of our units' keys is /team/units/<A>.id; a commit is one unit's order, signed by that unit.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, what was said on team chat, and orders the contract refused.

 0.0s  A0 move 12 15.6 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing east together to find enemies; stay grouped, focus fire on closest.
        A1 said: Holding together; focus fire on the closest enemy when they appear.
        A2 said: No enemies seen yet. Holding together; focus fire on the closest enemy when it appears.
 0.5s  A0 move 12 15.6 (45hp)  A1 move 11 15.6 (45hp)  A2 move 12 15.6 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing east slowly; A1, A2 follow and stay grouped. Focus fire closest.
        A1 said: Advancing east with A0 to stay grouped; will focus closest enemy.
        A2 said: Following A0 east to stay grouped; will focus closest enemy.
 1.0s  A0 move 12 15.6 (45hp)  A1 move 12 15.6 (45hp)  A2 move 12 16.5 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing east together; A1 and A2 keep close. Focus closest enemy.
        A1 said: Advancing east in formation; will focus closest enemy when seen.
        A2 said: Following east, staying grouped; will focus closest enemy when seen.
 1.5s  A0 hold (45hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 hold (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Enemies at 7+ range. Hold here grouped, focus E0 when in range.
        A1 said: E0 spotted at (18.3,16.8). Focus fire E0 together, stay grouped.
        A2 said: Enemies spotted east, 3 of them. Hold here and focus E0 when in range.
 2.0s  A0 attack E0 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 attack E0 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Focus E0 together now. A1 already attacking; A2 join in.
        A1 said: Holding at range; A0, A2 stay grouped. Focus E0 when it enters range 5.
        A2 said: Attacking E0 now, all focus E0 together.
 2.5s  A0 attack E0 (45hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 attack E0 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Focusing E0 now. A1, switch from hold to attack E0 too.
        A1 said: Attacking E0 now, in range 4.6. Focus fire together.
        A2 said: Focusing E0 now. A1, switch from hold to attack E0 too.
 3.0s  A0 attack E0 (36hp)  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 attack E0 (27hp)  |  E0 18hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 at 18hp, all keep focusing E0, then E1.
        A1 said: E0 at 18 HP, in range. Keep focusing, then switch to E1.
        A2 said: E0 at 18 health, finish it, then focus E2.
 3.5s  A0 attack E1 (27hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (9hp)  |  E0 dead  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 dead. Focus E1 together, then E2. A2 stay back, low health.
        A1 said: E0 dead. Focus E1 together, then E2. A2 stay back.
        A2 said: E0 dead. Focus E2 together, then E1. I'm at 9hp.
 4.0s  A0 attack E1 (18hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 36hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Focusing E1 (36hp), then E2. A0 at 18hp, A1 keep firing.
        A1 said: Focusing E1 (36hp), in range. A0 stay behind me, low health.
 4.5s  A0 attack E1 (18hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 27hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Continuing E1 (27hp). A1 keep firing; then E2.
        A1 said: Firing on E1 (27hp). A0 stay back, then we switch to E2.
 5.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 9hp  E2 45hp
        A1 said: A1 finishing E1 (9hp), then E2. A0 and A2 are down.
 5.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E1 (36hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 9hp  E2 45hp
        A1 said: Finishing E1 (9hp), then E2. A1 last unit standing.
 6.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (27hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 dead  E2 45hp
        A1 said: E1 down. A1 last unit, engaging E2.
 6.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (18hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 dead  E2 36hp
        A1 said: A1 last unit, E2 at 36hp in range, firing.
 7.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (18hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 dead  E2 27hp
        A1 said: A1 last unit, E2 at 27hp in range, firing.
 7.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (9hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 dead  E2 27hp
        A1 said: A1 last unit, E2 at 27hp in range, firing.
 8.0s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 dead  E1 dead  E2 18hp

The contract has no rules yet.
Write ONE new rule for the contract that would have helped you win this battle. It will be turned into a
Modality formula and checked against every order in later battles, so it must be about the orders units may
commit and the facts above, naming the paths. Make it one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "A unit may commit an order of the form \"attack E<n>\" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2."}
